title: Indru Netru Naalai
desc: Friends Elango and Pulivetti stumble upon a time machine and exploit it for personal gain. Things take a turn when they alter a gangster's fate, leading to unforeseen and dangerous consequences.

title: Hyper
desc: Suryanarayana Murthy is protective of his father, who is an honest government officer. However, when a politician causes trouble for his father, Surya strives to protect him.

title: Jackpot
desc: Two mischievous grifters stumble upon the secret of a magical vessel from an old lady. Subsequently, they embark on a wild and hilarious adventure to acquire it.

title: Action Hero Biju
desc: Biju Poulose leaves his teaching job to pursue his dream of serving in the police force. Posted as the sub-inspector in Cochin, he has to handle notorious criminals who indulge in unlawful activities.

title: K.G.F: Chapter 1
desc: Rocky, a young man, seeks power and wealth in order to fulfil a promise to his dying mother. His quest takes him to Mumbai, where he gets involved with the notorious gold mafia.

title: Cadaver
desc: When two surgeons mysteriously get murdered by Vetri, a prisoner, the responsibility of locating his accomplice falls on the shoulders of a pathologist.

title: Ungalukkaga Oruvan
desc: A wealthy entrepreneur returns home to reconcile with a former classmate. Upon discovering his companion's dire predicament, he intervenes and becomes a heroic saviour for the entire community.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Amara Kaviyam
desc: Karthika and Jeeva, two college-going students, fall in love with each other but are forced to separate by their families. However, when they try to reunite, tragedy strikes.

title: Imaikkaa Nodigal
desc: Anjali Vikramadithyan, a CBI officer, sets out to track down a serial killer who the police claim was killed years ago. However, the investigation becomes personal when the killer targets her family.

title: Sembi
desc: Sembi and her grandmother, Veerathayi, travel in a bus, along with 24 passengers, who strive to help the duo seek justice for the wrongs done to them.

title: Pathu Endrathukulla
desc: A driving instructor is tasked to deliver Shakeela, a young woman, to a landlord in Mussoorie. But soon, he finds out that her life is in danger and decides to be her saviour.

title: Adanga Maru
desc: Subhash, a daredevil officer, raises his voice against injustice when he comes across a few politically influential people. However, when his family is brutally murdered, he sets out to exact revenge.

title: Double Ismart
desc: A dying criminal enlists a rogue scientist to transfer his mind into a savvy street renegade, using a special brain port. Chaos and adventure ensue!
